title: A Github Project A Day — Today’s Project is Opencode! #opensource #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: a GitHub project a day. [music] Today's project is Open Code. Open Code is an AI coding agent built for the terminal, giving you total control and freedom to use any provider, [music] any model, and any editor. No browser, no bloat, just fast [music] coding with AI right where devs live most, the command line. Open code gives you [music] full control and connects to any model you want. Open AAI, Anthropic, even your own local models. It's got a beautiful native TUI, [music] automatic LSP loading, and multi-session support, meaning you can run multiple AI agents on the same project in parallel with over 28,000 GitHub stars and 200,000 devs using it every
